findings.issue: The rendered builder (desktop screenshot) shows the four-audiences Task ending at 'Do not change any facts.' It is missing the JSON guard sentence 'Use only the source facts; name missing details rather than inventing them.' The page data is out of sync with content/nonprofit-companion.json. The other presets may also be stale, including the funder 'No next-term plan is provided' instruction.
findings.exactFix: Regenerate NONPROFIT_PRESETS from content/nonprofit-companion.json, or read it from that file, so all three presets match role, task, context, format, source and review word for word. Then re-check the rendered preview text for each preset.

findings.issue: Each Context pastes the whole source string, including its 'Fictional source:' or 'Fictional figures:' label. This produces 'Source message: Fictional source: Harbor Lane Youth Club...' and the doubled punctuation "15:00.'." seen in the preview. It reads as a paste error inside a prompt that participants copy.
findings.exactFix: In each Context, insert the source text without its leading label. Example: "Source message (invented): Harbor Lane Youth Club. 'Our summer program is full. ... weekdays 9:00 to 15:00.'" End it with no extra period. Leave the 'source' field (the note beside the preview) labelled as it is.

findings.issue: The funder Format says 'End with one line on next term.' The Context says no plan exists and asks for it to be marked as a question. The model may still write a commitment to satisfy the Format.
findings.exactFix: Change the end of the Format to: 'End with one line stating that the next-term plan is an open question for the team.'

findings.issue: On phone, the preset text overflows the fixed-height textareas, so the Context and Format text is clipped mid-line inside a small scroll box. The fields and preview also stack, so the reference note sits far below.
findings.exactFix: Under @media(max-width:760px), set .prompt-field textarea{min-height:12em}. Alternatively, size each textarea's rows to its content when a preset loads, by setting field.rows from the line count in loadPreset.

findings.issue: In the recipe list on phone, the external-link arrow wraps onto its own line. 'Month-end documentation pack' and 'Workflow automation in your own workspace' both leave an orphaned arrow.
findings.exactFix: Wrap the last word and the arrow together, e.g. pack ↗, and add .nowrap{white-space:nowrap}. Alternatively, add the arrow with a non-breaking space in the template.

findings.issue: After a participant edits a preset, the state label changes to 'Your edited prompt'. The 'Fictional source' and review panel still shows the old preset's text with no cue that it relates to the starting version.
findings.exactFix: In the input handler, keep the panel visible but set its heading to 'Started from: <preset label>' when selected is cleared after a preset load. Hide the panel only on Clear.

alignment: Aligns with the official reference and the owner's scope. The site follows the official AI Lab agenda and is labelled as an optional companion, with no endorsement or employer branding. All nine recipes link to /build only, and prices and plans are deferred to /stack. The page sets out the representative types/decides and coaches ask questions guidance. It treats hesitation with respect and explains R-T-C-F. It frames the goal as one person, one moment of use and a 15-second demonstration, and offers the knowledge base as the smaller fallback. The data rule lists the official categories. Review covers accuracy, privacy and voice, and work is saved in the participant's own workspace. The 48-hour application follows the organization's data rules. Presets are labelled as starting prompts, not AI answers, and the builder makes no AI calls and sends nothing. The 13 activities remain clearly optional. The one real alignment gap is the stale rendered preset text: the live page omits the 'do not invent' guard that the JSON specifies.
visualScope: Reviewed seven static screenshots only: home desktop, home phone, companion top desktop, companion top phone, builder desktop, builder phone and recipe list phone. No interaction, clipboard, screen reader, keyboard or print tests were run or are claimed. In the screenshots, the hierarchy, page order and existing typography read clearly. Mobile is one column with tap targets of 44px or more. The observed issues are the clipped textareas and orphaned arrows on phone, and the out-of-date preset text on desktop.
